_comment: Example of tuning the CAD layer rules to another office standard (German layer names). Copy, edit, and point LAYER_RULES_FILE at it. Patterns are case-insensitive fnmatch globs; 'exclude_layers' win over 'layers'; door 'blocks' match block names. Default rules (src/database/layer_rules.json) already cover AIA/NCS names such as A-WALL, A-DOOR, A-FLOR.
